title: 第5章 提升实力第6章 紧迫
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条

清晨的阳光穿过“铜酒杯”旅店略显陈旧的百叶窗，在木质地板上投下一排斑驳的光栅。
维克多睁开眼，盯着陌生的天花板发了几秒钟的呆，才意识到自己并没有睡在那间充满霉味和血腥气的林中小屋里，也没有睡在随时可能有野兽路过的泥泞路边。
身下的床垫填充满了干燥的稻草，虽然不算柔软，但对于这几天的他来说，简直是云端般的享受。
他翻身坐起，第一件事就是摸向枕头底下。
那里压着昨晚剩下的那几十枚银币和一把铜子儿。钱还在，门后的椅子也还死死地顶着门把手。
“安全。”
维克多长舒一口气，简单的洗漱后，他整理好衣物，将那张沉重的变异野猪皮和巨大的獠牙重新打包。
黑石镇的皮毛收购商位于铁匠铺隔壁，店主是一个叫做汉森的秃顶老头，因为早年当过随军铁匠，大家都叫他“老铁钳”。他和老约翰是多年的酒友，以前老约翰打到了好皮子，多半都是卖给他。
当维克多把那张散发着淡淡腥气、泛着金属光泽的黑红猪皮摊开在柜台上时，老铁钳手里那杯刚泡好的麦茶差点泼在上面。
“诸神在上……”
老铁钳带上单片眼镜，粗糙的手指沿着野猪皮背部那条被硬生生炸开、又被维克多简单处理过的裂口抚摸过去，指尖微微颤抖，“这皮质的硬度……变异种么？”
“镇子上的传言是真的？”老铁钳压低了声音，像是怕惊动了什么，“那老倔头……真的一箭射爆了这家伙的头盖骨？还突破了？”
维克多此时正坐在一旁的高脚凳上，看似随意地摆弄着那根巨大的獠牙，实则在观察老铁钳的反应。
他没有直接回答，而是露出了一个属于“大人物学徒”的苦笑：
“汉森大叔，您知道老约翰的脾气。他昨晚收拾东西走的时候，还在抱怨这头猪弄坏了他的屋顶。至于那一箭……”维克多顿了顿，眼神显得有些迷离，“我当时吓坏了，只看到一道白光，然后这头大家伙就倒下了。其他的，我也不敢多问。”
老铁钳倒吸一口冷气，态度瞬间变得更加亲热。
原本这种有破损的皮毛，通常会以此为借口压价个两三成，但老铁钳这次连提都没提瑕疵的事。
“好小子，这东西我收了。虽然背部有点破损，但这可是变异种的皮！”
老铁钳从柜台下面的铁盒子里数出了整整3枚金币，又加了50枚银币，推到了维克多面前。

“如果是去城里价格可能还能再高点，但在黑石镇，我敢说没人出得比我高。”老铁钳把金币擦得铮亮，“等你叔成了正式游侠回来，记得让他来我这喝一杯，我请客。”
“一定。”
维克多没有讨价还价，爽快地收起了钱。
这个价格已经非常公道。按照正常物价，一张完整的普通野猪皮顶多值几十个银币，这已经是十倍的溢价了。这里面固然有变异种本身值钱的缘故，但至少有一枚金币，是老铁钳给那位“未来银星游侠”交的保护费。
接着他又去武器铺那里，把那一对半米多的獠牙也换成了金币。
这里的货币体系出奇地稳健，金、银、铜币之间严格遵循百进制兑换，省去了不少繁琐换算的麻烦。
从隔壁的武器铺出来后，维克多身上的总资产已经达到了六枚金币之多。
尽管如此，但是变异钢鬃野猪身上最值钱的战利品其实还没有换成金币。
维克多直奔位于镇中心的冒险者协会。
相比于充满市井气息的皮毛店，冒险者协会的大厅则显得严肃冷清许多。巨大的悬赏栏上贴满了羊皮纸，只有寥寥几个冒险者在柜台前交接任务。
维克多来到“素材鉴定与回收”的窗口。
当值的炼金术士是一个穿着灰色长袍、面色苍白的中年人。他接过维克多递过去的那个布袋，将里面几块大小不一的黑紫色水晶倒在托盘上。
“嗯？”

The early morning sunlight passes through the slightly outdated shutters of the "Copper Wine Glass" hotel, casting a row of mottled gratings on the wooden floor.
Victor opened his eyes and stared at the unfamiliar ceiling for a few seconds before he realized that he was not sleeping in that forest hut that was full of musty and bloody smells, nor was he sleeping on a muddy roadside where wild beasts might pass by at any time.
The mattress under him was filled with dry straw. Although it was not soft, for him these days, it was like a cloud-like enjoyment.
He turned over and sat up, and the first thing he did was to touch under the pillow.
There were dozens of silver coins and a handful of coppers left over from last night. The money was still there, and the chair behind the door was still pressed against the doorknob.
"Safe."
Victor breathed a sigh of relief. After a brief wash, he arranged his clothes and repacked the heavy mutated boar skin and huge tusks.
The fur buyer in Blackstone Town is located next to the blacksmith shop. The owner of the shop is a bald old man named Hansen. Because he was a blacksmith with the army in his early years, everyone calls him "Old Iron Tong". He and Old John have been drinking friends for many years. In the past, when Old John found good deals, he would usually sell them to him.
When Victor spread the black and red pigskin that exuded a faint fishy smell and had a metallic luster on the counter, the cup of freshly brewed barley tea in Old Tieqi's hand almost spilled on it.
"Gods above..."
Old Tieqiu put on his monocle and stroked his rough fingers along the crack on the back of the boar's skin that was blasted open and simply treated by Victor. His fingertips trembled slightly, "The hardness of this leather... is it a mutant?"
"Are the rumors in the town true?" Old Tieqi lowered his voice, as if he was afraid of disturbing something, "The old stubborn man...really shot this guy's skull with one arrow? Did he break through?"
Victor was sitting on a high stool nearby, seemingly playing with the huge fangs casually, but in fact he was observing the reaction of the old iron pliers.
He did not answer directly, but showed a wry smile belonging to a "big man's apprentice":
"Uncle Hansen, you know Old John's temper. When he packed up and left last night, he was still complaining that the pig damaged his roof. As for the arrow..." Victor paused, his eyes looking a little blurry, "I was frightened at the time. I only saw a white light, and then the big guy fell down. I didn't dare to ask about anything else."
Old Tieqiu took a breath of air, and his attitude instantly became more affectionate.
Normally, this kind of damaged fur would usually be used as an excuse to lower the price by 20 to 30%, but Lao Tieqi didn't even mention the defect this time.
"Good boy, I'll take this thing. Although the back is a little damaged, it's the skin of a mutant!"
The old iron tongs counted out three gold coins from the iron box under the counter, added another 50 silver coins, and pushed them in front of Victor.
"If you go to the city, the price may be higher, but in Blackstone Town, I dare say that no one pays more than me." The old iron tongs polished the gold coins. "When your uncle comes back as an official ranger, remember to ask him to come to my place for a drink. I'll treat you."
"Definitely."
Victor didn't bargain and kept the money readily.
The price is very reasonable. According to normal prices, a complete ordinary wild boar skin is worth dozens of silver coins at most, which is already a tenfold premium. Although the mutant itself was valuable, at least one gold coin was the protection fee paid by Old Iron Clamp to the "Future Silver Star Ranger".
Then he went to the weapons shop and exchanged the pair of half-meter long fangs for gold coins.
The currency system here is surprisingly stable. The exchange of gold, silver and copper coins strictly follows the centimetre system, which saves a lot of tedious conversion troubles.
After coming out of the weapons shop next door, Victor's total assets have reached six gold coins.
Despite this, the mutated steel-maned wild boar is the most valuableThe loot has not actually been converted into gold coins.
Victor went straight to the Adventurers Association in the center of the town.
Compared to the fur shop, which is full of market atmosphere, the lobby of the Adventurers Association looks much more serious and deserted. The huge bounty column was covered with parchment, and only a few adventurers were handing over tasks in front of the counter.
Victor came to the "Material Identification and Recycling" window.
The alchemist on duty was a middle-aged man wearing gray robes and looking pale. He took the bag handed over by Victor and poured several pieces of black and purple crystals of different sizes inside onto the tray.
"Um?"
